description: This PHP file generates a pie chart visualization for test platform results within the TestLink project. It includes dependencies on data classes and charting libraries, interacts with test plan metrics, and outputs a pie chart representing test status distributions per platform.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Determines if a user has the rights to access test plan metrics.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes request arguments for the script, handling API key validation and session setup.
